title: The First Hot Air Balloon Passengers Were a Sheep, a Duck and a Rooster

scenes.text: The first passengers in a hot air balloon were a sheep, a duck, and a rooster.
It happened on September 19th, 1783, in front of the king of France.
Nobody knew if living things could survive in the air.
So the balloon went up with animals first, for about eight minutes.
It landed nearly two miles away. All three animals were fine.
The sheep reportedly kicked the rooster mid-flight.

description:
On September 19th, 1783, a sheep, a duck, and a rooster became the first hot air balloon passengers.
The flight lasted about eight minutes and landed nearly two miles away. All three survived.
Which animal would you have sent up first?
